name: stash-relay
description: Cloudflare Worker that mints short-lived Qobuz FLAC URLs for the Stash app from a small pool of operator-owned accounts. Audio never transits it.

scripts.report: wrangler d1 execute stash-relay --remote --command "SELECT day, ip, COUNT(*) AS installs, SUM(n) AS plays FROM quota WHERE key LIKE 'i:%' AND ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY day, ip ORDER BY installs DESC, plays DESC LIMIT 25"
